alex: Quick noteAll-hands recap + follow-ups. Thanks to everyone who joined. Recording + slides link at the bottom. :wave:

sarah: TL;DR: hiring cadence doubled in Q1, Hosted API latency improved 12% median after the kernel fixes, and Dedicated GA next month.

marta: Ops/Incidents brief: we had a partial embed outage last week (region us-west-2) from a routing misconfig during a burst. Root cause: new fallbacks not honoring sticky routes. Mitigation: immediate rollback + hotfix.

ken: What we changed: added an extra validation step in the routing planner, updated canary gating to include route_stability checks, and added an alert for >1% failed fallbacks in 5m. No customer data was affected.

julie: Policy update (short): retention baseline extended 90 -> 180 days for service logs; enterprise opt-in for 3-year exports available via support. FAQ and schema mapping will be in the policy doc.

alex: Product highlight: demo of the routing optimizer (Miguel's work) reduced cold-route latencies for long-context generation by ~25% in our benchmarks. We'll publish the benchmark harness soon.

marta: Follow-ups assigned: ENG-2473 (routing validation), SRE-518 (alert tuning), DOCS-912 (audit export examples). Managers please pull one blocker for Friday's sync.

ken: Customer impact note: customers on committed Dedicated contracts were unaffected. Hosted API customers saw a transient spike; we issued status updates and credits where appropriate.

julie: Compliance note: audit export will now include model_variant and route_id fields; see the schema in the policy doc for SIEM mapping.

alex: Action items for folks: engineers - add any demo logs you want surfaced by EOD Thursday. Managers - gather 1 hiring ask + 1 risk for Friday roundtable. Product - post the benchmark link when ready.

alex: Thanks all. Short written follow-ups will be posted to the all-hands doc; if you need deeper dive, schedule a 1:1 with the relevant owner. :sparkles:
